nodes.label: scripts/seed-kotlin-settings.js (seeds the fwcd.kotlin settings for the file editor)
nodes.doc: workbench.md ('Testing the bridge from outside', Seeding): run by entrypoint.sh and yarn start; refuses (exit 1, writes nothing) on any read error but ENOENT, keeps the file mode, leaves kotlin.java.home alone without a runtime; writes ~/.continuum/settings.json + globalStorage/fwcd.kotlin/config.json; rewrites kotlin.languageServer.path (the launcher) and kotlin.java.home on every start, other keys only when absent; JSONC tolerant, atomic, one settings.json.continuum-backup; an unparsable file -> exit 1, untouched, the container still starts. Finding ST-12 (NIT, FIXED in fix round 2, VERIFIED in round 3): a leading UTF-8 BOM is stripped before parsing; BOM + plain JSON -> exit 0, mark gone, user keys kept, marker written, no backup; BOM + commented file -> merged, backup keeps the original bytes incl. the BOM; a BOM-only file counts as empty; BOM + broken JSON -> exit 1, untouched, no marker (host seedscript group 4/4, in-image direct/commented/entrypoint BOM checks)

nodes.label: Finding ST-11 (MINOR, FIXED in fix round 2, VERIFIED in round 3 on the dev bundle and the image): DiagnosticsNudge sent version+1 and never recorded it, so the first client edit after a (re)start was ignored by the server. Fix: every didOpen/didChange/replay/nudge the bridge sends carries a per-document strictly increasing OpenDocument.serverVersion (nextServerVersion); the client keeps its own numbering
nodes.doc: DiagnosticsNudge.ts:33 re-sends each open document 500 ms after ready as a full-text didChange with document.version + 1; OpenDocuments keeps v, fwcd ignores versions not above its stored one, and the client's next edit (version 2 after the open at 1) is exactly that version. Effect: stale markers or one failed completion/hover (-32603; server log 'Reached end of file before reaching char 29') until the next keystroke heals it (full-text sync). Applies to every document open when the nudge fires: cold start, idle restart, crash/OOM restart (the replay sends the recorded version, then +1). Regression check: ONLY=coldwindow, 'the first edit after the bridge re-sent the open documents is applied by the server' (failed in round 2 on dev and image; passes in round 3: 9/9 original, 10/10 with the typed-error check; the first edit at version 2 is applied at all 7 offsets +0..1500 ms; the image's server log no longer has 'Reached end of file', round 2: 4 per run). Fix options: one monotonic bridge-to-server version per document rewritten on every forwarded didOpen/didChange, or nudge with didClose + didOpen. Real-browser effect NOT VERIFIED. workbench.md: 'Testing the bridge from outside'

nodes.label: Pitfall (found in round 3): the local Docker tag projectcontinuum/continuum-workbench:0.0.16 is not a reliable pre-feature baseline - on 2026-11-28 01:06 IST it was overwritten by a local build of the working tree (5.47 GB, Kotlin layers, ENV CONTINUUM_KOTLIN_LS_HOME), and the system tests' own stack uses that tag for its workbench service
nodes.doc: The genuine release is projectcontinuum/continuum-workbench@sha256:2c44cb8ab9d1388683fc060e8013e207c77e4ee7e28b5456273a481bc5570716 (amd64, 4,378,995,222 bytes, no seed script, entrypoint without the seeding): docker pull by digest leaves the local tag alone; tag it kotlin-lsp-systest-<round>-baseline:0.0.16. continuum-system-tests/docker/docker-compose.yml line 391 pins the same tag for the continuum-workbench service, so make up would start the local build (inferred from compose's default pull policy, not run). The image driver (BASELINE_IMAGE) now SKIPs its two baseline comparisons, NOT VERIFIED, when the baseline carries CONTINUUM_KOTLIN_LS_HOME (hasKotlinSupport in lib/image-probe.mjs). workbench.md: 'Testing the bridge from outside', Image runs

nodes.label: Pitfall (fixed in build #3): any Monaco model with language id `kotlin` starts the fwcd.kotlin extension and its own ~0.85 GB JVM
nodes.doc: verified CONTNM-180 browser round 1: opening only a Script dialog (or a Rest/Create Table/Claude dialog, through the `|| 'kotlin'` fallback) started the extension server with no .kt open; with the bridge server that was ~1.75 GB. FIXED and re-verified in round 2: the dialog editor uses its own Monaco id `continuum-kotlin-script` (common/DialogEditorLanguage.ts), a Script dialog alone = exactly 1 bridge JVM, Rest/Create Table/Claude = 0 JVMs; the extension wakes only for .kt/.kts files. Guard in tests: count JVMs by parentage and never call monaco.editor.tokenize(..., 'kotlin') while measuring. workbench.md: 'Kotlin in the browser'

nodes.doc: relative paths written for the source layout resolved one folder too high (KotlinServerLaunchSpec dev default ../../../../.kotlin-ls), so dev needed CONTINUUM_KOTLIN_LS_HOME. FIXED in the fix round (dev dir found by walking up to scripts/download-kotlin-ls.sh); browser round 2 verified a backend started without the env var. workbench.md: 'Kotlin in the browser'

nodes.label: Pitfall: the stock fwcd kotlin-language-server 1.3.13 emits no syntax (parser) diagnostics
nodes.doc: proven in CONTNM-180 browser round 2 with direct JSON-RPC probes of the real server (wrapped script and plain .kt text): missing closing brace or parenthesis, `val = 3`, junk at top level, unclosed string, extra `)` -> zero diagnostics; only semantic ones (type mismatch, unused variable, unreachable code). So the review item 'unclosed brace is flagged on the last script line' (showTrailingErrorsOnLastUserLine in the Kotlin registration) can never trigger; the node reports the compile error when it runs. Options: accept/document or add an own bracket-balance check. workbench.md: 'Kotlin in the browser'

nodes.label: Pitfall: the script wrapper is a function body, so valid script-level object/enum class/interface/typealias get false error markers
nodes.doc: CONTNM-180 browser round 2: with `fun continuumScript<key>(row, flow): Any? = run { <script> }` the editor shows 'Named object cannot be local', 'Modifier enum is not applicable to local class', 'interface so it cannot be local', 'Nested and local type aliases are not supported' (also const val / import after code in a direct probe); class and fun are fine; header placement (leading block comment, KDoc, @file:) is handled. Whether the node's JSR-223 engine accepts these declarations is NOT VERIFIED. Options: filter those messages (diagnosticFilter), document the limit, or change the wrapper. workbench.md: 'Kotlin in the browser'
